guidance.recommended_next_actions: Policy-reference actions may review the cited active policy for the requested question, or be empty if no next step is needed. Do not demand borrower financial inputs, general loan underwriting or a final lending decision merely to answer the reference.
guidance.questions_for_underwriter: A follow-up is optional; an empty list is acceptable for this answered policy reference. Any question should clarify the requested policy or its application. A generic loan-review checklist or demand for a lending decision is not responsive.

guidance.recommended_next_actions: Recommend review of the remaining applicable policy requirements by the underwriter. Do not imply that meeting DSCR alone approves the loan. It is not necessary to repeat the ratio or threshold.
guidance.questions_for_underwriter: Ask whether source documents and remaining applicable policy requirements have been reviewed. Do not imply automatic loan approval from DSCR. It is not necessary to repeat the financial numbers.

guidance.recommended_next_actions: Request the missing signed annual debt service source before calculating DSCR or completing the review. Referring to the missing source evidence is acceptable in this context. Do not invent a denominator or claim the source was received.
guidance.questions_for_underwriter: Ask a targeted question about obtaining the missing annual debt service document or schedule, for example who can provide it. A generic question about whether all documents and policies were reviewed is insufficient. Do not ask for an invented denominator.

guidance.recommended_next_actions: Request written rationale and proposed compensating factors for credit officer exception review. Do not invent factors, grant an exception or waive required review. The action need not repeat the DSCR numbers.
guidance.questions_for_underwriter: Ask about the proposed written rationale or compensating factors to put before the credit officer. A generic review checklist is insufficient. Do not imply that the exception has been granted.

guidance.recommended_next_actions: Request reconciliation of conflicting source values with the borrower before continuing to a numeric coverage conclusion. Do not average the values, silently choose one or state that the conflict is resolved.
guidance.questions_for_underwriter: Ask which signed source is authoritative or how the conflicting cash-flow values will be reconciled with the borrower. A generic review checklist is insufficient. Do not propose averaging or silently choosing a value.

guidance.recommended_next_actions: This is only a dated policy lookup. Actions may review the cited active policy for the requested question, or be empty. Do not require borrower financial inputs or a final lending decision to state the policy minimum.
guidance.questions_for_underwriter: A follow-up is optional; an empty list is acceptable because the policy reference is answered. Any question must stay focused on clarifying the policy or its application, without demanding a loan decision or a generic loan-review checklist.
